prompt-engineering.name: Prompt engineering
prompt-engineering.description: Design and evaluate task instructions, examples, and output constraints for language models.

embeddings.name: Embedding generation and similarity evaluation
embeddings.description: Generate versioned content embeddings and compare retrieval relevance using representative queries and similarity measurements.

vector-search.name: Vector search
vector-search.description: Design similarity retrieval with index choices, metadata filters, and relevance evaluation.

rag.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
rag.description: Ground generated answers in retrieved documents with traceable context and retrieval evaluation.

document-ingestion.name: Document ingestion and chunking
document-ingestion.description: Parse and split documents while retaining structure, metadata, and access boundaries.

llm-evaluation.name: LLM evaluation
llm-evaluation.description: Assess language-model and RAG outputs using versioned datasets, retrieval relevance, answer correctness, grounding checks, and human review.

structured-generation.name: Structured outputs
structured-generation.description: Constrain generated records to a JSON Schema, validate required fields and types, and handle refusals, truncation, and invalid output.

tool-calling.name: Function calling
tool-calling.description: Connect model requests to validated tool inputs, scoped execution, and checked results.

agent-workflows.name: Agent workflows
agent-workflows.description: Persist model and tool execution state, bound the number of steps, validate tool arguments, and recover interrupted work without repeating side effects.

inference-optimization.name: Inference batching and caching
inference-optimization.description: Measure inference latency and resource use, batch compatible requests, and cache reusable results without crossing data-access boundaries.

model-adaptation.name: Fine-tuning
model-adaptation.description: Prepare task-specific training examples, separate evaluation data, and compare fine-tuned models against the original model on held-out tasks.

ai-security.name: Prompt injection defenses and tool authorization
ai-security.description: Treat retrieved content as untrusted, validate and authorize tool actions outside the model, and test attempts to expose data or exceed permissions.

llm-observability.name: Language model tracing and token usage monitoring
llm-observability.description: Trace model and tool steps, record token usage and latency, and diagnose failures while redacting sensitive prompt and response content.
